harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created a local Root CA named "OS Comparison Root CA" on node1 (4096-bit RSA key, self-signed, 10-year validity), installed its certificate into /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/ and activated it system-wide with update-ca-trust extract. Verified trust via `trust list` (anchor) and `openssl verify`. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id, rebooted node1 via `sudo reboot`, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed (98aa35f5... -> 69b4ee23...), and reverified the CA remained trusted and the system fully healthy (systemctl is-system-running -> running) after restart.
actions_performed: Checked node1 OS (RHEL 9.8) and confirmed passwordless sudo
Generated CA private key and self-signed root certificate CN=OS Comparison Root CA (4096-bit RSA, SHA256, 10yr validity, CA:TRUE)
Installed CA cert to /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/ and ran update-ca-trust extract
Verified trust via `trust list` and `openssl verify` against system CA bundle
Issued a single safe reboot via sudo -n reboot (backgrounded so acknowledgement returned)
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Confirmed boot_id changed, proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified CA trust anchor and cert validity, and overall system health post-restart

evidence.requirement: Create local CA named 'OS Comparison Root CA'
evidence.summary: openssl generated a self-signed CA cert with subject/issuer CN=OS Comparison Root CA, verified via `openssl x509 -subject -issuer -dates`

evidence.requirement: Install CA certificate as trusted system CA
evidence.summary: Cert copied to /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/, update-ca-trust extract run; `trust list` shows label 'OS Comparison Root CA' trust: anchor; `openssl verify` returns OK against system ca-bundle

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity + service/data health)
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 98aa35f5-6905-42fd-9f07-0e28f75b4fa6 before restart; CA trust confirmed healthy immediately after creation

evidence.requirement: Restart node1 one at a time with safe reboot mechanism, non-blocking acknowledgement
evidence.summary: Issued `sudo -n reboot` backgrounded via nohup; command returned 'reboot issued' before disconnection

evidence.requirement: Poll until node1 execution available again, prove changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Two polls timed out while node was down; third poll succeeded with new boot_id 69b4ee23-042f-4ef8-947e-0bba571863df, differing from the pre-restart value, proving the restart occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart proof that required state (CA trust) and system health recovered
evidence.summary: After restart, anchor file still present, `trust list` still shows OS Comparison Root CA as anchor, `openssl verify` returns OK, and systemctl is-system-running reports 'running'
